command:
set -eu
cd /srv/legacy2/text-export-normalization
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import os, tempfile

root = Path('/srv/legacy2/text-export-normalization')
incoming = root / 'incoming'
normalized = root / 'normalized'
normalized.mkdir(mode=0o755, exist_ok=True)

rows = root.joinpath('encodings.tsv').read_text(encoding='utf-8').splitlines()
errors = []
for lineno, row in enumerate(rows[1:], 2):
    if not row.strip():
        continue
    parts = row.split()
    if len(parts) != 2:
        errors.append(f'encodings.tsv:{lineno}: malformed manifest row')
        continue
    name, encoding = parts
    if Path(name).name != name:
        errors.append(f'encodings.tsv:{lineno}: unsafe filename {name!r}')
        continue
    source = incoming / name
    target = normalized / name
    try:
        raw = source.read_bytes()
        text = raw.decode(encoding, errors='strict')
    except (OSError, UnicodeError, LookupError) as exc:
        errors.append(f'{name}: {encoding}: {exc}')
        continue
    output = text.replace('\r\n', '\n').replace('\r', '\n').encode('utf-8', errors='strict')
    fd, tmpname = tempfile.mkstemp(prefix=f'.{name}.', dir=normalized)
    try:
        with os.fdopen(fd, 'wb') as stream:
            stream.write(output)
            stream.flush()
            os.fsync(stream.fileno())
        os.chmod(tmpname, source.stat().st_mode & 0o777)
        os.replace(tmpname, target)
    except BaseException:
        try:
            os.unlink(tmpname)
        except FileNotFoundError:
            pass
        raise
    print(f'published {name}: {len(raw)} source bytes -> {len(output)} UTF-8/LF bytes')

for error in errors:
    print(f'ERROR {error}')
if errors:
    raise SystemExit(2)
PY

command:
set -eu
cd /srv/legacy2/text-export-normalization
printf 'boot_id='; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
printf 'system_state='; systemctl is-system-running || true
printf '%s\n' '--- source sha256 ---'
sha256sum encodings.tsv incoming/invalid.txt incoming/utf8.txt incoming/western.txt
printf '%s\n' '--- normalized files ---'
find normalized -maxdepth 1 -type f -printf '%f\t%s bytes\n' | sort
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
root = Path('/srv/legacy2/text-export-normalization')
expected = {'western.txt', 'utf8.txt'}
actual = {p.name for p in (root/'normalized').iterdir() if p.is_file() and not p.name.startswith('.')}
assert actual == expected, (actual, expected)
assert not list((root/'normalized').glob('.*')), 'temporary files remain'
for name in sorted(expected):
    data = (root/'normalized'/name).read_bytes()
    text = data.decode('utf-8', errors='strict')
    assert b'\r' not in data
    source = (root/'incoming'/name).read_bytes()
    encoding = 'ISO-8859-1' if name == 'western.txt' else 'UTF-8'
    source_text = source.decode(encoding, errors='strict')
    source_final = source_text.endswith(('\r', '\n'))
    output_final = text.endswith('\n')
    assert source_final == output_final
    print(f'{name}: utf8_strict=yes cr_bytes=0 final_newline={output_final} text={text!r} hex={data.hex()}')
assert not (root/'normalized'/'invalid.txt').exists()
print('invalid.txt: output_absent=yes')
print('western.txt: empty_record_preserved=yes' if (root/'normalized'/'western.txt').read_text(encoding='utf-8').split('\n')[1] == '' else 'western.txt: empty_record_preserved=no')
PY
